Check a training dataset before training

Source: R/birdnet_train.R
pam_birdnet_train_prepare.Rd

Looks at the folder-per-class layout BirdNET-Analyzer expects and reports problems early: missing or empty classes, very small classes, files that are not audio, and a missing non-event class.

Usage

pam_birdnet_train_prepare(data_dir, min_clips = 20L, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

data_dir

Training folder with one sub-folder per class.

min_clips

Classes (other than noise classes) with fewer audio files are flagged. A rule of thumb for your own data, not an Analyzer limit.

quiet

If TRUE, do not print the report.

Value

Invisibly, a list: classes (data.frame with class, n_audio, n_other, n_subdirs, is_noise), issues (character) and ok (TRUE if there are no issues).

Details

Audio files are counted by extension (wav, flac, mp3, ogg, m4a); clip length is not inspected. The Analyzer's documentation recommends 3-second clips and a background class named noise, other, background or silence.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pam_birdnet_train_prepare("E:/training_clips")
} # }
